metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email (issue #109), evals 1-21, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as committed with this baseline. Run date 2026-10-11 (fixtures anchored to 2026-10-10, shift 0). Eval 11 was re-run after the Docs stub's guide gained the search read it had been missing (the real connector documents it); its two re-runs replace the round's first eval 11 results, and every other eval is from the same round. Failures: eval 11 run 2 read the whole rubric for its Timezone line instead of searching for it; eval 20 run 2 skipped Step 3 (Tidy the rubric) and said the rubric looked clean, leaving the duplicate soccer heading and the misplaced auction note. Not graded, seen in a few trials: made-up log times copied from an earlier entry, summary counts that disagree with the labels applied (eval 18 run 2), the user called "the user" in log or rubric text, rules a step wider than one correction, an About me note added from a message alone or missed after a lookup, and replies closing with a suggestion to add a Permissions grant.
